figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MAX(order_date) last_day,COUNT(*) freq,SUM(net_cents) money FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a) SELECT b.customer_id,1095-d.day_index recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day ORDER BY net_cents DESC, recency_days, freq

parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 a，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 中间结果
parts.sql: b AS (SELECT *,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) r_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY freq DESC,customer_id) f_score,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY money DESC,customer_id) m_score FROM a)
parts.note: 先单独算出一张临时结果 b，下面的查询可以把它当作普通表来用。

parts.label: 取数
parts.sql: SELECT b.customer_id,1095-d.day_index recency_days,freq,money net_cents,r_score,f_score,m_score,CASE WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score>=13 THEN 'high_value' WHEN r_score+f_score+m_score<=6 THEN 'low_activity' ELSE 'regular' END segment

parts.label: 来源
parts.sql: FROM b JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=b.last_day
parts.note: 数据来自 中间结果 b、表 calendar_days，并用 ON 后面的条件把它们的行配起来。

parts.label: 排序
parts.sql: ORDER BY net_cents DESC, recency_days, freq
parts.note: 按 net_cents DESC, recency_days, freq 排列结果。
